questions.text: Explain in your own words what the payback period of a project means.
questions.correctAnswer: The payback period is the amount of time it takes for a project to recover its initial investment or initial cost from the cash inflows generated by the project.
aiRubric: Explains that payback is a period of time.
Explains that the project is recovering the original or initial investment/cost.
Accepts different wording if the meaning is correct.
questions.aiReferenceNotes: Payback analysis determines how much time will pass before accrued benefits overtake accrued and continuing costs. It is the time needed to recoup the total amount invested.

study.title: Payback period in simple English
study.simple: Payback period tells you how long it takes before the money coming back from a project has recovered the money that was invested at the start.
steps: Start with the initial project cost.
Add the cash coming in year by year.
The point where the cumulative amount reaches the original cost is the payback point.
study.remember: Payback = how long until we get the original investment back?
